name: Chestnut-capped Puffbird
rangeDescription: Southeastern colombia to venezuela, northern bolivia, and western amazonian brazil
description: Attractive small puffbird of lowland rainforest. White below, reddish brown above, with a black mask and single black breast band.

name: Black-breasted Barbet
rangeDescription: Southern chad to northeastern central african republic, south sudan, northeastern democratic republic of the congo, and northern uganda
description: Large, mostly black barbet with a huge white bill. Note the black breast and the red, white, and black belly.

name: Sri Lanka Spurfowl
rangeDescription: Humid forest of southern sri lanka
description: Partridgelike bird. Male unmistakable, with conspicuous white spots and streaks covering body.

name: Tepui Goldenthroat
rangeDescription: Tepuis of southern venezuela and adjacent brazil (roraima)
description: Medium-sized green hummingbird with a rounded, white-tipped tail and decurved black bill, found only in the tepui region of Venezuela and Guyana. Female is very similar to male but with some spotting on the green underparts.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Sunda Minivet
rangeDescription: Highlands of sumatra and java
description: Brightly-colored and long-tailed inhabitant of foothill and montane forests in Java and Sumatra (1200-2700 meters). Social, often traveling in large flocks in the forest canopy.

name: Sumatran Green-Pigeon
rangeDescription: Montane forest of sumatra and western java
description: Relatively plain and unmarked green-pigeon with a long pointed tail. Males have a faint orange blush on the chest, though this can be hard to notice.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Chestnut-bellied Chat-Tyrant
rangeDescription: Andes of colombia, ecuador (entire east slope, southward on the west slope to chimborazo), and far northern peru (east slope, north and west of the marañón valley)
description: Small, attractive flycatcher that lives near rushing streams inside Andean cloud forest. Its white eyebrows really stand out and can look like headlights in the dark forest; plumage is otherwise gray and chestnut.

name: Andaman Serpent-Eagle
rangeDescription: Forest of andaman islands
description: A relatively small, uniformly dark brown eagle with a contrasting bright-yellow bare patch between the eye and the bill. The underparts are speckled with small white spots.

name: Coastal Cisticola
rangeDescription: Coastal southern somalia to kenya and northern tanzania
description: A relatively colorful, medium-sized, long-tailed cisticola. Note the gray-brown back with thick black streaks, the brown on the wing and cap, and the whitish underparts.

name: Yellow-lored Amazon
rangeDescription: Southeastern mexico (yucatán peninsula and cozumel) to belize
description: Fairly small parrot of the Yucatan Peninsula, often in the same areas as the rather similar White-fronted Parrot, but the two species do not seem to mix in the same flocks. Found in forest and edge, less often in semi-open areas with scattered trees.

name: Cape Rockjumper
rangeDescription: South africa (western and eastern cape province)
description: A striking, gregarious bird that bounces about on rocky mountain slopes and crags in fynbos habitat. The sexes differ: the male has a dark rufous belly and rump, a black throat, and a white moustache; the female is duller, with a streaked chest.

name: Eastern Crowned Warbler
rangeDescription: Siberia and northern china; winters in southeastern asia and greater sundas
description: A boldly marked songbird, rather large for a leaf warbler, usually seen foraging in the canopy. From below, a bright yellow vent and broad orange-based bill distinguish it from most other local leaf- warblers.

name: Bryan's Shearwater
rangeDescription: Range poorly known; discovered on midway island (hawaii), but probably breeds bonin islands (japan)
description: Smallest known shearwater. Tiny, black and white shearwater with rapidly fluttering wingbeats and an entirely white face.

name: Brown-capped Rosy-Finch
rangeDescription: Mountains of southeastern wyoming, colorado, and north-central new mexico
description: The rosy-finch with the most restricted range in Colorado and northern New Mexico. Body is milk-chocolate brown.

name: Common Pochard
rangeDescription: Palearctic, breeding british isles and southern scandinavia eastward through east-central russia, in south from iberian peninsula and türkiye eastward through northeastern china; winters to tropical africa and india eastward to japan and southward to the northern philippines
description: Mid-sized diving duck. Male distinctive, with dark rusty head, pale gray body contrasting with black breast, and broad pale bluish band on bill.

name: Bare-throated Tiger-Heron
rangeDescription: Wet lowlands of coastal western and eastern mexico (from southern sonora and southern tamaulipas) southward through central america to far northwestern colombia (lower atrato valley), with an extremely disjunct population in northwestern peru
description: A large but rather short-legged, primal-looking heron of mangroves and freshwater marshes in tropical lowlands. Often in areas with trees, but also around ponds in rather open marshes.

name: Madagascar Cisticola
rangeDescription: Grassland of madagascar and aldabra (southwestern seychelles)
description: Tiny brown bird with a long tail and bill. Note streaked back and pale underparts.

name: Firewood-gatherer
rangeDescription: Savanna of paraguay to southern brazil, uruguay, and central argentina
description: Small ovenbird species with brown streaks above and faded buff-streaks below. Note the rufous forehead and white eyebrow and throat.

name: Bismarck Kingfisher
rangeDescription: Lowlands of bismarck archipelago
description: A medium-sized blue-and-white kingfisher with a big, heavy black bill. Bluish-green upperparts and chest band contrast with creamy white underparts and white neck patch.

name: Ochre-browed Thistletail
rangeDescription: Andes of western venezuela (northern táchira, mérida, and trujillo)
description: Tiny bird with a long, spiky red tail, a vocal and active resident of grass and bushes above treeline. Dull brown upperparts, grayish brown underparts, and a distinctive orange face and chin.
